examCheckpoints.label: Exam checkpoints
examCheckpoints.description: Share of checkpoints reached in the race exam (all races together). Higher is better.

examFinished.label: Exam races finished
examFinished.description: Share of races finished in the race exam.

heldOutSuccess.label: Held-out targets reached
heldOutSuccess.description: Fixed held-out scenarios at the hardest curriculum level: share of targets reached by the winner.

exam.label: Exam score
exam.description: Race exam score: 1000 per missed checkpoint + seconds + distance left (lower is better). Sums over races, so compare equal exam sizes only.

examCrashes.label: Exam crashes
examCrashes.description: Crashes in the race exam, all races together.

heldOut.label: Held-out score
heldOut.description: Score on the fixed held-out scenarios at the hardest level (lower is better).

success.label: Training success
success.description: Share of targets the winner reached in this generation's scenarios and level.

score.label: Training winner score
score.description: The winner's score. Scenarios change every generation, so this is not a progress measure.

reevalScore.label: Re-eval score
reevalScore.description: Re-evaluation: the winner's score on the extra scenarios.

reevalSuccess.label: Re-eval success
reevalSuccess.description: Re-evaluation: the winner's share of targets on the extra scenarios.

level.label: Curriculum level
level.description: Curriculum level flown in the generation (0 = easiest).

examRobust.label: Robust exam score
examRobust.description: Robustness exam score: the same races with input delay and noise (lower is better).

examRobustCheckpoints.label: Robust exam checkpoints
examRobustCheckpoints.description: Robustness exam: share of checkpoints reached.

examRobustFinished.label: Robust exam finished
examRobustFinished.description: Robustness exam: share of races finished.

examRobustCrashes.label: Robust exam crashes
examRobustCrashes.description: Robustness exam: crashes, all races together.

sigma.label: Mutation sigma
sigma.description: Mutation sigma: scheduled, or the winner's self-adaptive sigma.

tps.label: Ticks per second
tps.description: Game ticks simulated per second. Timing only, not a result.

ticks.label: Ticks per generation
ticks.description: Game ticks simulated in the generation. Timing only.

shipStepsPerSec.label: Ship-steps per second
shipStepsPerSec.description: Moving ships x frames per second: the real simulation work. Timing only.

shipSteps.label: Ship-steps per generation
shipSteps.description: Ship-steps simulated in the generation. Timing only.

spin.label: Winner spin
spin.description: Mean |turn output| of the winner (1 = always turning at full rate).

skillStop.label: Skill: Stop
skillStop.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of stop: arrive below the speed limit (braking). The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillStopCrashes.label: Crashes: Stop
skillStopCrashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on stop: arrive below the speed limit (braking).

skillTurnAndGo.label: Skill: Turn and go
skillTurnAndGo.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of turn-and-go: start fast, facing away, then reach the target. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillTurnAndGoCrashes.label: Crashes: Turn and go
skillTurnAndGoCrashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on turn-and-go: start fast, facing away, then reach the target.

skillChain.label: Skill: Chain
skillChain.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of chain: 3-5 targets in a row, each leg turning. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillChainCrashes.label: Crashes: Chain
skillChainCrashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on chain: 3-5 targets in a row, each leg turning.

skillCorridor.label: Skill: Corridor
skillCorridor.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of corridor: reach a target round the bends of an asteroid corridor. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillCorridorCrashes.label: Crashes: Corridor
skillCorridorCrashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on corridor: reach a target round the bends of an asteroid corridor.

skillField.label: Skill: Field
skillField.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of field: a chain of targets through a dense asteroid field. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillFieldCrashes.label: Crashes: Field
skillFieldCrashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on field: a chain of targets through a dense asteroid field.

skillRaceLegs.label: Skill: Race legs
skillRaceLegs.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of race-legs: consecutive checkpoints of a real race track. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillRaceLegsCrashes.label: Crashes: Race legs
skillRaceLegsCrashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on race-legs: consecutive checkpoints of a real race track.

skillRock1.label: Skill: Rock in line
skillRock1.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of rock-in-line with 1 rock across the direct line. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillRock1Crashes.label: Crashes: Rock in line
skillRock1Crashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on rock-in-line with 1 rock across the direct line.

skillRock2.label: Skill: Two rocks in line
skillRock2.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of rock-in-line with 2 rocks across the direct line. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillRock2Crashes.label: Crashes: Two rocks in line
skillRock2Crashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on rock-in-line with 2 rocks across the direct line.

skillField80.label: Skill: 80 rocks
skillField80.description: Skills exam: share of targets reached on fixed scenarios of point-to-point among 80 scattered asteroids. The same scenarios for every model (seeded from the exam seed).

skillField80Crashes.label: Crashes: 80 rocks
skillField80Crashes.description: Skills exam: crashes per episode on point-to-point among 80 scattered asteroids.
